originals.why: Rendered as 'he isn't supposed to ~' (o = 그) because 그것 cannot tell 'o' from 'hi'. The Welsh is natural and open-ended.
hi = 그녀 keeps it apart from 'dydy o'. 'but she isn't ~' is a valid reading of the Welsh.
hi = 그녀, so it cannot be heard as 'dydy o ddim fel hyn'. The Welsh is natural.
'tydy?' is the tag question 'isn't it?', not the negative 'dydy … ddim' this LEGO teaches. Korean also cannot tell mae o'n from mae hi'n.

originals.ko: 그건 아주 잘 가고 있어, 그렇지 않아?
originals.why: 'tydy?' is the tag question, not the negative 'dydy … ddim' this LEGO teaches.
Here 'it' has to be hi, but Korean 그것 fits 'dydy o ddim yn y Gymraeg' just as well, and 그녀 makes no sense. Two answers are possible.
